verdict.rationale: Eqvista's support docs include articles on downloading Extended and Summary cap table reports, so the product has its own cap table export capability. However, the evidence names no file format, and the transaction timeline is documented only as something to view, not export. Migration and import material covers the reverse direction, and the round-modeling PDF is a different feature, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: confirmation that exports are in Excel/CSV, export of the full transaction history, evidence that the complete cap table can be exported at any time on every plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
